chunks: They will go round and around between it and boiling water.

key_terms.يَطُوفُونَ: They will go round and around / circulate

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says people will go round and round between boiling water?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rahman vividly depicts the restless torment of the disbelievers, who are forced to circulate between the scalding water (Hamim) and the burning fire, symbolizing a state of perpetual agitation without respite. The 'boiling water' is often interpreted as the sweat or excrement of the inhabitants of Hell, emphasizing the degradation and continuous suffering of those who rejected divine guidance. This imagery serves as a stark contrast to the tranquility promised to the righteous, reinforcing the concept of divine justice in the afterlife.
